label: preparing
what: A surprise community supper for the mayor at the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, aiming for 200 loaves, with lantern lighting, grain procurement, baking and bread deliveries. The mayor was told of an approved lighting/readiness check, not the supper. Baker knowingly provided oven access and later bread; neighbour assisted supply enquiries and maintained discretion; watchman knew of the supper and deliberately avoided spoiling it, though material preparation help is not established. Secretary arranged the approved hall appointment, but knowing assistance with the concealed supper is not established.
